def longest_common_prefix(strs):
    if not strs:
        return ""
    
    shortest = min(strs, key=len)
    for i in range(len(shortest)):
        if all(s[i] == shortest[i] for s in strs):
            continue
        else:
            return shortest[:i]
    return shortest

It iterates through each character of the shortest string and checks if this character matches at the same position in all other strings. If a mismatch is found, it returns the substring of the shortest string up to the current index. If no mismatches are found after checking all characters, it returns the entire shortest string as the longest common prefix. def valid_parentheses(s):
    stack = []
    mapping = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}
    
    for char in s:
        if char in mapping.values():
            stack.append(char)
        elif char in mapping.keys():
            if not stack or stack.pop() != mapping[char]:
                return False
    
    return len(stack) == 0
